text: The pipes tool reports only the first break it meets from the starting point, so when a fluid line is dry, also run pipes from the source end (pumpjack, pump or infinity pipe) and fix every break between the two ends in one plan. Look out for pipe-to-ground pairs that face the same way, because they don't connect.

text: When the supplies for a long-distance job sit in a chest far from the character (fetch only searches ~400 tiles), start the plan with a move next to that chest and take steps there before any fetch or build. Put the power line to a midline pump before the pump and pipe steps, and check that the pump has power before the plan's final checks.
